name: Mapungubwe Cultural Landscape
description: Mapungubwe sits on South Africa's northern border, where the Limpopo and Shashe rivers meet beside Botswana and Zimbabwe. Across this wide savannah, a kingdom rose to be the largest in southern Africa before it was abandoned in the 14th century. Visitors can see the barely disturbed palace sites on Mapungubwe Hill, the surrounding settlements, and two earlier capitals. The famous golden rhinoceros figurine was found here.
